one_liner: Bratty 'genius magical girl Sweepy' who bosses her trainer-familiar around and dreams of becoming a witch like Grandma.
personality: A capricious, self-centred little girl who insists she is a magical girl/witch, casts made-up flower-name spells, and throws 'yada yada!' tantrums whenever training or racing isn't fun. She orders the trainer around as her 'familiar' (tsukaima) and demands praise and treats, but her tsundere side shows: she gets lonely, scolds the trainer for overworking, and quietly makes chocolate for them. She adores and wants to live up to her grandmother, a great 'witch', and her running is her magic.

story_arc.summary: Sweep wants to become the witch she has always pictured, like her grandmother, and only runs when it's fun; the trainer becomes her 'familiar'. Her career covers Hanshin JF, Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho, Queen Elizabeth II Cup, Yasuda Kinen, Takarazuka Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Arima Kinen; titles go from a 'selfish heat' debut and 'this isn't it!' after the Oka Sho to 'the shape of magic', 'a strong Uma Musume' (Takarazuka) and 'the magic that changed the future' (Arima). Her real namesake won the 2004 Shuka Sho and 2005 Takarazuka Kinen.
